title: NumericalPDE PorousMediumTravelingWave

stats.done_summary: Successfully completed the NumericalPDE PorousMediumTravelingWave research task. Implemented numerical integration of the porous medium equation traveling wave ODE using a backward integration strategy to handle the degenerate singularity at f=0 for m>1. Verified solutions using algebraic residuals (first integral form), achieving mean residuals of 10^-4 to 10^-5 and relative errors below 10^-8 for nonlinear cases. Generated 6 figures and a comprehensive research report with methodology, results, and discussion.
